productConnection: Pip is a tiny patch fox with an oversized mint hook-tail; a visible stitched repair makes maintenance part of the silhouette instead of a pasted logo.
silhouette: An oversized rounded fox head taking about 62 percent of total height, two compact pointed ears, a tiny pear-shaped body, four very short limbs, and one large mint tail curling into a soft hook silhouette.
proportions: Head is 1.55 times the body width; hands and feet are tiny rounded nubs; tail is almost as tall as the body but never hides the face.
faceRule: Two large dark navy oval eyes with one small ivory catchlight each, a tiny charcoal button nose, a short w-shaped mouth, and two restrained coral cheek dots.
signatureFeature: The large mint hook-tail always carries one small yellow repair patch with a compact row of coral stitches.
appealHook: The oversized head, tiny paws, and one visibly repaired tail make Pip feel helpful and slightly imperfect.
renderingRule: Premium matte soft-vinyl designer toy with subtle microtexture, clean rounded seams, warm ivory studio background, soft diffused product lighting, gentle contact shadow, no fur strands.
clearSpace: Keep empty space equal to one ear height around the full silhouette.
avoids: No insect body, bracket panels around the face, oversized machinery, or bulky torso.
No text, letters, framework logos, UI panels, computers, or invented claims.
No realistic animal anatomy, fur strands, plush fabric, glossy plastic, anime styling, or identity drift.
